snippet.title: Hablet - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Hablet - Out Now!
https://piouspigeon.itch.io/hablet

A habit game for Playdate.
Build a little city one day at a time with the help from the enigmatic Concierge. 
Think you can beat entropy? 

-A game by Pious Pigeon
-Music by Will Hitch
https://open.spotify.com/album/0fOod43BYxrEWQG0qaDWZU?si=-DTKm7zLRFSAjqM9FDTfvg
